commanders.name: Trajan

skills.name: Trajan's Column
skills.effect: Deals direct damage to the target. This commander's troops and nearby friendly troops gain bonus skill damage and extra Rage every second for 3 seconds; the target takes 25% more damage for 3 seconds. (Testo ricostruito da zathong/theriagames/rok.guide via snippet: 'Causes the target to take direct damage. This commander's troops... earn bonus skill damage and 15 extra rage every second for three seconds'; 'The debuff makes the target receive 25% more damage'.)

skills.name: Expanding Borders
skills.effect: Increases the defense of troops led by this commander (20% at max level) and increases their health by 20% while outside alliance territory.

skills.name: Great Expeditions
skills.effect: Increases troop capacity by 10%. When leading at least 3 different troop types, the active skill deals additional direct damage (Damage Factor 300) and the target takes 20% more damage for 4 seconds.

skills.name: Battle of Tapae
skills.effect: Normal attacks grant a stacking defense bonus, up to 10 stacks, lasting 10 seconds; can be activated once every 8 seconds. (Valori numerici per stack non trovati.)

skills.name: Five Good Emperors
skills.effect: Enhances Trajan's Column: deals direct damage (Damage Factor 400) to the target; this commander's troops and nearby friendly troops gain 30% bonus skill damage and 50 Rage per second for 3 seconds; the target takes 25% more damage for 3 seconds.

talent_builds.stat_summary: Rigenerazione rage (Rejuvenate +150 rage per skill attiva), riduzione danno da skill, +20% difesa 2s dopo la skill attiva (Strategic Prowess), bonus truppe miste.
talent_builds.notes: Albero Versatility non usato. Trajan va usato come primario per attivare i talenti. Se abbinato a un healer, sostituire Armored to the Teeth con talenti di cura del Support tree (allclash). Truppe miste (3 tipi) obbligatorie per Great Expeditions.

talent_builds.stat_summary: Stessa impostazione del build da campo aperto; Expanding Borders lo rende forte fuori dal territorio alleanza (AoO/Canyon).
talent_builds.notes: theriagames: ottimo in Ark of Osiris, Lost Kingdom e scontri prolungati; sconsigliato per rally e attacco/difesa strutture.

pairings.note: La 4a skill di Harald conta come attiva e innesca i talenti di Trajan (allclash).
Aethelflaed primaria per 'nascondere' Trajan, che viene cacciato con priorita' (allclash).
Buff universali a tutti i tipi di truppa (allclash/hokbuild).
Dalla pagina Suleiman di allclash: entrambi truppe miste.
Dalla pagina Bertrand di allclash: Trajan secondario come supporto.
Dalla pagina Shajar di allclash: talento Healing Herbs +9% cura.

skills.effect: Deals direct damage to a target troop (Damage Factor 2800) and reduces its march speed (up to 50%). Also heals (Healing Factor up to 2000); over the next 10 seconds healing is converted into true damage. (riseofkingdomsguides la descrive come 'ibrido attivo/passivo'.)

skills.name: Strength of the Sultana
skills.effect: Archer units gain 35% Health and 20% March Speed.

skills.name: Dew of Devotion
skills.effect: While on the map, troops take up to 10% reduced damage; using skills triggers healing of nearby troops (Healing Factor up to 500), at most once every 3 seconds.

skills.name: Braving the Danger
skills.effect: While on the map, troops take up to 20% reduced damage. When units drop to 60%, triggers a large heal (Healing Factor up to 5000) with a cooldown, at the cost of a 40% attack loss.

skills.name: Pearlescent Heart
skills.effect: Healed troops gain 10% Defense and deal 20% increased normal damage for 3 seconds.

talent_builds.stat_summary: hokbuild: All for One 3/3, Burning Blood 3/3, Rejuvenate 1/1, Feral Nature 5/5, Clarity 3/3, Heraldic Shield 3/3 - supporto con capacita' di danno.
talent_builds.notes: allclash: build ancora in sviluppo ('check back later'); usata soprattutto in Canyon (S+). riseofkingdomsguides: solo immagine, 'non ancora rilasciata'.

pairings.note: Sinergia limitata in guarnigione (allclash pagina Choe Yeong).

commanders.recommended_equipment: allclash: Starter Helm of Phoenix / Milanese Plate / Blessed Blade; Advanced Revival Helm / Revival Plate / Golden Age; Progressed Dragon's Breath Helm / Plate / Bow; Final Ancestral Mask of Night / Dragon's Breath Plate / The Hydra's Blast. hokbuild: set Dragon's Breath completo (Boots, Plate, Vambraces, Helm, Tassets, Bow).
commanders.notes: Arciere di supporto/cura con conversione cura->danno vero. Tier list allclash: 'overpowered in canyon' con la 4a skill (S+). hokbuild: 'difficile da ottenere'. riseofkingdomsguides (2026-01) attendeva il rilascio in gioco per dare consigli d'investimento.

commanders.name: Belisarius Prime

skills.name: Custodian of the Empire
skills.effect: Deals direct damage to a target troop (Damage Factor 2400). For the next 2 seconds, the target loses 50 Rage per second. If the target is surrounded, applies Deception (its skills require 200 more Rage).

skills.name: Press the Advantage
skills.effect: Cavalry units gain 30% Attack and 20% March Speed; after leaving combat they gain 60% March Speed for 5 seconds.

skills.name: To the Last Man
skills.effect: Cavalry units gain 25% Defense. While this commander's troop is on the map, whenever it launches a basic attack it has a 10% chance to deal extra direct damage (Damage Factor 500).

skills.name: Pacification of Nika
skills.effect: Troop takes 10% less skill damage; deals 30% more skill damage against weakened targets (below 80% units).

skills.name: Roman Devotion
skills.effect: Surrounded targets take increased damage (6% to 12% depending on the number of troops surrounding them).

talent_builds.stat_summary: Velocita' di marcia e attacco, difesa, riduzione danno (hokbuild).
talent_builds.notes: riseofkingdomsguides: ottimo per campo aperto, caccia alle farm e per bloccare la rage nemica. allclash: l'albero Mobility gli impedisce di essere un buon primario (poco danno); meglio come secondario; utile in AoO. Solo cavalleria.

pairings.note: Joan Prime primaria con Support tree: 'pairing dolcissimo' per quasi ogni situazione (allclash).
Entrambi cavalleria; Nevsky porta il danno (allclash).

commanders.recommended_equipment: hokbuild: Witch's Lineage, Dark Lord's Blessing, Golden Age, Seth's Brutality, Gladiator, Boots of the Hellish Wasteland. allclash starter: Windswept War Helm, Windswept Breastplate, Vanguard Halberd (resto PRO).
commanders.notes: Cavalleria mobile anti-swarm: drena rage e aumenta il costo delle skill nemiche (Deception). Tier list allclash: 'alza la rage del bersaglio, previene lo swarm'. Nessuna cura. riseofkingdomsguides: 'se sei F2P non investire'.

commanders.name: Eleanor of Aquitaine

skills.name: Lily of the Wilds
skills.effect: Deals direct damage to the target (Damage Factor 2300) and reduces skill damage taken by 10% for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Lionmother
skills.effect: Cavalry units gain 20% Attack; while garrisoning, troops take 15% less counterattack damage.

skills.name: Rock Crystal Vase
skills.effect: Cavalry units gain 15% Defense; when hit, 10% chance to trigger Lily of the Wilds.

skills.name: Grandmother of Europe
skills.effect: Troops deal 10% increased damage; while garrisoning, after using the active skill nearby troops receive a buff (up to 10%).

skills.name: Duchess of Aquitaine
skills.effect: Troops take 5% less damage and deal 10% more skill damage to the current target.

talent_builds.stat_summary: hokbuild: Impenetrable Fortifications 3, King's Guard 3 e altri nodi difensivi del Garrison tree.
talent_builds.notes: allclash: come primaria serve il Garrison tree; ideale a difendere un passo rinforzando con cavalleria. riseofkingdomsguides: solo immagine.

pairings.note: Jan Zizka primario per sopravvivenza (riseofkingdomsguides); sinergia cavalleria (allclash).

commanders.recommended_equipment: allclash: Starter Windswept War Helm / Windswept Breastplate / Vanguard Halberd; Advanced Expedition War Helm / Heart of the Saint; Final Pride of the Khan / Heavy Armor of Hellish Wasteland / Sacred Dominion. hokbuild: War Helm, Heavy Armor, Armband e Tassets of the Hellish Wasteland, Staff of the Lost, Roaring Wolf's Claws.
commanders.notes: Cavalleria da guarnigione per passi/strutture. Giudizi contrastanti: allclash S+ in difesa; riseofkingdomsguides la definisce 'estremamente scarsa' con guarnigione debole e sconsiglia l'investimento ai F2P. Basso danno.
gaps: natura esatta del buff ai vicini di Grandmother of Europe

commanders.name: William Wallace

skills.name: Bas Agus Buaidh
skills.effect: Deals smite damage to the target (Damage Factor 2400), plus extra smite damage to up to 3 enemies attacking this troop (Damage Factor 300).

skills.name: Scots Wha Hae
skills.effect: Infantry units gain 10% Health, 30% Attack and 20% March Speed.

skills.name: Lion of the North
skills.effect: Troop takes 10% less normal damage; smite attacks with Damage Factor above 1000 have an 80% chance to deal 40% increased damage (cooldown 10 seconds).

skills.name: Battle of Stirling Bridge
skills.effect: When attacking, the troop deals 10% more smite damage and 10% more normal damage.

skills.name: Pro Libertate
skills.effect: Dispels slow effects from up to 3 nearby troops and grants a damage-absorbing shield (Factor 1000) for 2 seconds (cooldown 10 seconds).

talent_builds.stat_summary: Smite tree completo fino al nodo finale, poi Infantry.
talent_builds.notes: allclash: 'tutti i talenti sono buoni, poco da rimpiangere'. riseofkingdomsguides: build Smite per massimizzare il danno smite. hokbuild mostra due build (solo immagini). Solo fanteria.

pairings.note: Miglior pairing: 'Liu Che e' il miglior comandante fanteria' (riseofkingdomsguides, allclash, hokbuild).
Valido ma Liu Che e' meglio (allclash, hokbuild).
Dalla pagina Stephen III di hokbuild.

commanders.notes: Fanteria Smite: 'uno dei comandanti piu' forti del gioco' (riseofkingdomsguides), budget-friendly (buono a 5515). Tier list allclash: S campo aperto. Lento, senza AoE. Civilta' non riportata da nessuna fonte raggiunta.

commanders.name: Scipio Aemilianus

skills.name: Africanus
skills.effect: Deals smite damage to a target troop (Damage Factor 2700). For the next 3 seconds, the target takes 20% more damage.

skills.name: Huntmaster
skills.effect: Infantry units gain 20% March Speed outside alliance territory; when rallied, infantry units gain 30% Health.

skills.name: Dawn of Rome
skills.effect: This commander's troop deals 5% more normal damage; has a chance (up to 30%) to gain debuff immunity / reduce damage taken by up to 25%.

skills.name: Salt the Earth
skills.effect: When attacking cities, 50% chance to reduce the target's attack and defense by 25%; when this commander is primary, also applies silence.

skills.name: Tit for Tat
skills.effect: Whenever the current target of this commander's troop uses an active skill, this commander's troop gains Rage 40% faster for the next 2 seconds.

talent_builds.stat_summary: Un solo build 'che ha senso' dato il ruolo specifico (allclash).
talent_builds.notes: Dettagli dei talenti dietro paywall allclash PRO; riseofkingdomsguides: focus rally attacking.

Alternativa con buona sinergia; applicazioni limitate in campo aperto (riseofkingdomsguides, allclash).

commanders.name: John Hunyadi

skills.name: Raven's Wings
skills.effect: Deals ranged direct damage to a target troop (Damage Factor 900, 1600 if the target is within melee range). For the next 3 seconds, this commander's troop deals 20% more ranged skill damage.

skills.name: Sword in the Sky
skills.effect: This commander's siege units gain 30% Attack. While their troop is in ranged mode, it gains Rage 15% faster.

skills.name: Shield of Belgrade
skills.effect: Whenever this commander's troop uses an active skill, it has a 20% chance to deal extra ranged direct damage to its current target (Damage Factor 300). Chance to trigger is increased to 40% if the target is not within melee range.

skills.name: Knight of the Noon Bell
skills.effect: This commander's troop deals 40% more damage to troops with less than 50% units remaining.

skills.name: Glory Eternal
skills.effect: Whenever this commander's troop uses an active skill, it has a 40% chance to deal extra ranged direct damage to its current target (Damage Factor 400) and gain 30 Rage. Chance to trigger is increased to 80% if the target is not within melee range.
